label: Non-food-contact surfaces
description: Non-food contact surface or equipment made of unacceptable material, not kept clean, or not properly sealed, raised, spaced or movable to allow accessibility for cleaning on all sides, above and underneath the unit.

label: Pest entry or harborage conditions
description: Establishment is not free of harborage or conditions conducive to rodents, insects or other pests.

label: Cold holding temperature
description: Cold TCS food item held above 41 °F; smoked or processed fish held above 38 °F; intact raw eggs held above 45 °F; or reduced oxygen packaged (ROP) TCS foods held above required temperatures except during active necessary preparation.

label: Food-contact surface cleaning
description: Food contact surface not properly washed, rinsed and sanitized after each use and following any activity when contamination may have occurred.

label: Food or equipment protection
description: Food, supplies, or equipment not protected from potential source of contamination during storage, preparation, transportation, display, service or from customer’s refillable, reusable container. Condiments not in single-service containers or dispensed directly by the vendor.

label: Plumbing and drainage
description: Anti-siphonage or back-flow prevention device not provided where required; equipment or floor not properly drained; sewage disposal system in disrepair or not functioning properly. Condensation or liquid waste improperly disposed of.

label: Hot holding temperature
description: Hot TCS food item not held at or above 140 °F.

label: Mice or evidence of mice
description: Evidence of mice or live mice in establishment's food or non-food areas.

label: Flies or other nuisance pests
description: Filth flies or food/refuse/sewage associated with (FRSA) flies or other nuisance pests in establishment’s food and/or non-food areas. FRSA flies include house flies, blow flies, bottle flies, flesh flies, drain flies, Phorid flies and fruit flies.

label: Tableware washing and sanitizing
description: Dishwashing and ware washing: Cleaning and sanitizing of tableware, including dishes, utensils, and equipment deficient.

label: Food Protection Certificate
description: Food Protection Certificate (FPC) not held by manager or supervisor of food operations.

label: Food adulteration or contamination
description: Raw, cooked or prepared food is adulterated, contaminated, cross-contaminated, or not discarded in accordance with HACCP plan.

label: Wiping-cloth storage
description: Wiping cloths not stored clean and dry, or in a sanitizing solution, between uses.

label: Sanitized equipment or utensil use/storage
description: Sanitized equipment or utensil, including in-use food dispensing utensil, improperly used or stored.

label: Hand-washing facilities
description: No hand washing facility in or adjacent to toilet room or within 25 feet of a food preparation, food service or ware washing area. Hand washing facility not accessible, obstructed or used for non-hand washing purposes. No hot and cold running water or water at inadequate pressure. No soap or acceptable hand-drying device.

label: Pesticide not properly labeled or used by unlicensed individual
description: Pesticide not properly labeled or used by unlicensed individual. Pesticide, other toxic chemical improperly used/stored. Unprotected, unlocked bait station used.

label: Personal cleanliness is inadequate
description: Personal cleanliness is inadequate. Outer garment soiled with possible contaminant. Effective hair restraint not worn where required. Jewelry worn on hands or arms. Fingernail polish worn or fingernails not kept clean and trimmed.

label: Cockroaches
description: Live roaches in facility's food or non-food area.

label: Design, construction, materials used or maintenance of food contact surface improper
description: Design, construction, materials used or maintenance of food contact surface improper. Surface not easily cleanable, sanitized and maintained.

label: Single-service articles
description: Single service article not provided. Single service article reused or not protected from contamination when transported, stored, dispensed. Drinking straws not completely enclosed in wrapper or dispensed from a sanitary device.

label: Thawing procedure improper
description: Thawing procedure improper.

label: After cooking or removal from hot holding, TCS food not cooled by an approved method whereby the internal temperature is reduced from 140 °F to 70 °F or less within 2 hours, and from 70 °F to 41 °F or less within 4 additional hours
description: After cooking or removal from hot holding, TCS food not cooled by an approved method whereby the internal temperature is reduced from 140 °F to 70 °F or less within 2 hours, and from 70 °F to 41 °F or less within 4 additional hours.

label: Evidence of rats or live rats in establishment's food or non-food areas
description: Evidence of rats or live rats in establishment's food or non-food areas.

label: Accurate thermometer not provided or properly located in refrigerated, cold storage or hot holding equipment
description: Accurate thermometer not provided or properly located in refrigerated, cold storage or hot holding equipment

label: Wash hands sign not posted near or above hand washing sink
description: Wash hands sign not posted near or above hand washing sink.

label: Contract with a pest management professional not in place
description: Contract with a pest management professional not in place. Record of extermination activities not kept on premises.

label: Garbage receptacle not pest or water resistant, with tight-fitting lids, and covered except while in active use
description: Garbage receptacle not pest or water resistant, with tight-fitting lids, and covered except while in active use. Garbage receptacle and cover not cleaned after emptying and prior to reuse. Garbage, refuse and other solid and liquid waste not collected, stored, removed and disposed of so as to prevent a nuisance.

label: Mechanical or natural ventilation not provided, inadequate, improperly installed, in disrepair or fails to prevent and control excessive build-up of grease, heat, steam condensation, vapors, odors, smoke or fumes
description: Mechanical or natural ventilation not provided, inadequate, improperly installed, in disrepair or fails to prevent and control excessive build-up of grease, heat, steam condensation, vapors, odors, smoke or fumes.

label: Properly scaled and calibrated thermometer or thermocouple not provided or not readily accessible in food preparation and hot/cold holding areas to measure temperatures of TCS foods during cooking, cooling, reheating, and holding
description: Properly scaled and calibrated thermometer or thermocouple not provided or not readily accessible in food preparation and hot/cold holding areas to measure temperatures of TCS foods during cooking, cooling, reheating, and holding.

label: Tobacco or electronic cigarette use, eating, or drinking from open container in food preparation, food storage or dishwashing area
description: Tobacco or electronic cigarette use, eating, or drinking from open container in food preparation, food storage or dishwashing area.

label: Food, prohibited, from unapproved or unknown source, home canned or home prepared
description: Food, prohibited, from unapproved or unknown source, home canned or home prepared. Animal slaughtered, butchered or dressed (eviscerated, skinned) in establishment. Reduced Oxygen Packaged (ROP) fish not frozen before processing. ROP food prepared on premises transported to another site.

label: Food worker/food vendor does not use utensil or other barrier to eliminate bare hand contact with food that will not receive adequate additional heat treatment
description: Food worker/food vendor does not use utensil or other barrier to eliminate bare hand contact with food that will not receive adequate additional heat treatment.

label: Toilet facility not maintained or provided with toilet paper, waste receptacle or self-closing door
description: Toilet facility not maintained or provided with toilet paper, waste receptacle or self-closing door.

label: Damaged canned food
description: Swollen, leaking, rusted or otherwise damaged canned food to be returned to distributor not segregated from intact product and clearly labeled DO NOT USE

label: Insufficient or no hot holding, cold storage or cold holding equipment provided to maintain Time/Temperature Control for Safety Foods (TCS) at required temperatures
description: Insufficient or no hot holding, cold storage or cold holding equipment provided to maintain Time/Temperature Control for Safety Foods (TCS) at required temperatures

label: Live animal other than fish in tank or service animal present in facility’s food or non-food area
description: Live animal other than fish in tank or service animal present in facility’s food or non-food area.

label: Food adulterated or misbranded
description: Food adulterated or misbranded. Adulterated or misbranded food possessed, being manufactured, produced, packed, sold, offered for sale, delivered or given away

label: No approved written standard operating procedure for avoiding contamination by refillable returnable containers
description: No approved written standard operating procedure for avoiding contamination by refillable returnable containers.

label: Hot TCS food item that has been cooked and cooled is being held for service without first being reheated to 165º F or above within 2 hours
description: Hot TCS food item that has been cooked and cooled is being held for service without first being reheated to 165º F or above within 2 hours.

label: Juice packaged on premises with no or incomplete label, no warning statement
description: Juice packaged on premises with no or incomplete label, no warning statement

label: Food contact surface, refillable, reusable containers, or equipment improperly constructed, placed or maintained
description: Food contact surface, refillable, reusable containers, or equipment improperly constructed, placed or maintained. Unacceptable material used. Culinary sink or other acceptable method not provided for washing food.

label: Time/Temperature Control for Safety (TCS) food not cooked to required minimum internal temperature
description: Time/Temperature Control for Safety (TCS) food not cooked to required minimum internal temperature.   • Poultry, poultry parts, ground and comminuted poultry, all stuffing containing poultry, meats, fish or ratites to or above 165 °F for 15 seconds with no interruption of the cooking process   • Ground meat, and food containing ground and comminuted meat, to or above 158 °F for 15 seconds with no interruption of the cooking process, except per individual customer request  • Pork, any food containing pork to or above 150 °F for 15 seconds  • Mechanically tenderized or injected meats to or above 155 °F.  • Whole meat roasts and beef steak to or above required temperature and time except per individual customer request  • Raw animal foods cooked in microwave to or above165 °F, covered, rotated or stirred   • All other foods to or above 140 °F for 15 seconds; shell eggs to or above 145 °F for 15 seconds except per individual customer request.

label: Food preparation area, food storage area, or other area used by employees or patrons, contaminated by sewage or liquid waste
description: Food preparation area, food storage area, or other area used by employees or patrons, contaminated by sewage or liquid waste.

label: Toxic chemical or pesticide improperly stored or used such that food contamination may occur
description: Toxic chemical or pesticide improperly stored or used such that food contamination may occur.

label: Lighting inadequate; permanent lighting not provided in food preparation areas, ware washing areas, and storage rooms
description: Lighting inadequate; permanent lighting not provided in food preparation areas, ware washing areas, and storage rooms. Shatterproof bulb or shield to prevent broken glass from falling into food or onto surfaces, not installed.

label: Shellfish not from approved source, not or improperly tagged/labeled; tags not retained for 90 days
description: Shellfish not from approved source, not or improperly tagged/labeled; tags not retained for 90 days.

label: Sewage disposal system is not provided, improper, inadequate or unapproved
description: Sewage disposal system is not provided, improper, inadequate or unapproved.

label: Meat, fish, molluscan shellfish, unpasteurized raw shell eggs, poultry or other TCS offered or served raw or undercooked and written notice not provided to consumer
description: Meat, fish, molluscan shellfish, unpasteurized raw shell eggs, poultry or other TCS offered or served raw or undercooked and written notice not provided to consumer.

label: TCS food removed from cold holding or prepared from or combined with ingredients at room temperature not cooled by an approved method to 41 °F or below within 4 hours
description: TCS food removed from cold holding or prepared from or combined with ingredients at room temperature not cooled by an approved method to 41 °F or below within 4 hours.

label: Food worker/food vendor does not wash hands thoroughly after using the toilet, or after coughing, sneezing, smoking, eating, preparing raw foods or otherwise contaminating hands or does not change gloves when required; Worker fails to refrain from smoking or being fully clothed in clean outer garments
description: Food worker/food vendor does not wash hands thoroughly after using the toilet, or after coughing, sneezing, smoking, eating, preparing raw foods or otherwise contaminating hands or does not change gloves when required; Worker fails to refrain from smoking or being fully clothed in clean outer garments.

label: Unclean or cracked whole eggs or unpasteurized liquid, frozen or powdered eggs kept or used
description: Unclean or cracked whole eggs or unpasteurized liquid, frozen or powdered eggs kept or used.

label: HACCP plan not approved or approved HACCP plan not maintained on premises
description: HACCP plan not approved or approved HACCP plan not maintained on premises.

label: Food containing a prohibited substance held, kept, offered, prepared, processed, packaged, or served
description: Food containing a prohibited substance held, kept, offered, prepared, processed, packaged, or served.

label: Harmful noxious gas or vapor detected
description: Harmful noxious gas or vapor detected. Carbon Monoxide (CO) level exceeds nine (9) ppm

label: Toilet facility not provided for employees or for patrons when required
description: Toilet facility not provided for employees or for patrons when required. Shared patron-employee toilet accessed through kitchen, food prep or storage area or utensil washing area.

label: Food service operation occurring in room or area used as living or sleeping quarters
description: Food service operation occurring in room or area used as living or sleeping quarters.

label: Commercially processed pre-cooked TCS in hermetically sealed containers and precooked TCS in intact packages from non-retail food processing establishments not heated to 140 °F within 2 hours of removal from container or package
description: Commercially processed pre-cooked TCS in hermetically sealed containers and precooked TCS in intact packages from non-retail food processing establishments not heated to 140 °F within 2 hours of removal from container or package.

label: No or inadequate potable water supply
description: No or inadequate potable water supply. Water or ice not potable or from unapproved source. Bottled water not NY State certified. Cross connection in potable water supply system.

label: Unapproved outdoor, street or sidewalk cooking
description: Unapproved outdoor, street or sidewalk cooking.

label: Duties of an officer of the Department interfered with or obstructed
description: Duties of an officer of the Department interfered with or obstructed.

label: Unpasteurized milk or milk product (except certain aged cheese) served
description: Unpasteurized milk or milk product (except certain aged cheese) served.

label: Raw fruit or vegetable not properly washed prior to cutting or serving
description: Raw fruit or vegetable not properly washed prior to cutting or serving.

label: Food worker or vendor working or is knowingly or negligently permitted to work in FSE while afflicted with infected wound or reportable communicable disease
description: Food worker or vendor working or is knowingly or negligently permitted to work in FSE while afflicted with infected wound or reportable communicable disease. No spitting allowed. Spitting anywhere in the establishment is prohibited.

label: Non-TCS food that has been served to the public being re-served
description: Non-TCS food that has been served to the public being re-served. (Does not apply to wrapped foods where the wrapper seal has not been broken or opened).

label: Food package (including canned food product or hermetically sealed container) not in good condition to the degree contents are not suitable for human consumption
description: Food package (including canned food product or hermetically sealed container) not in good condition to the degree contents are not suitable for human consumption. Package is swollen, leaking or rusted, without “DO NOT USE” label or not segregated from consumable food items.

label: Food not labeled in accordance with the approved HACCP plan
description: Food not labeled in accordance with the approved HACCP plan

label: HACCP records
description: Records and logs not maintained to show that approved HACCP plan has been properly implemented.
